page.overview:
Who is Abat?

Abat was a male Korban who worked as a miner and lived with his daughter, Aau, on the planet Korba.

Abat appeared in the short film "Aau's Song," the ninth episode of the anthology series Star Wars: Visions second season, which released Abat was voiced by Tumisho Masha.
